meta.title: Dovetail course
meta.description: Learn to cut dovetails by hand: spacing, marking, sawing, chopping — step by step, on the computer, in AR and in VR.

hero.title: Your first dovetail joint
hero.lead: Nine chapters from the board to the glued corner; chapters 1 to 3 are new, the rest is still a draft. In every chapter we show it first, then you do it yourself, and at the end you check on your own whether it fits.
hero.quelle: Layout rule: geometric dovetail spacing on the center line, following the Austrian carpentry textbook (Fachkunde Tischler), ch. 4.1 (in our own words).
hero.sicherheit: AR rule: with the headset on you only mark out and check. Never saw or chop with the headset on: watch first, headset off, then work.

schritt.kontrollpunkt: Checkpoint — how do you know it fits?
schritt.nachmachenAus: Help is off. Work towards the goal and check yourself at the checkpoint.

hilfe.label: Help
hilfe.erklaerung: As you get more confident, use less help. That is how you learn to work without instructions.

rechner.papier: On paper you round T first: T ≈ {t} → 2T ≈ {zweiT} → {ratio}T ≈ {hilf} mm. The calculator keeps the unrounded value; the difference is smaller than a pencil line.
rechner.winkelHinweis: Until the next stage the calculator uses a fixed 1:6 and the factor 1.7. 1:7 for hardwood and the 1.5 rule will be added there as options.

fehler.breite_ungueltig: Enter a board width between 40 and 600 mm.
fehler.dicke_ungueltig: Enter a board thickness between 8 and 50 mm.
fehler.dicke_zu_gross: The board is too thick for this width.
fehler.azs_ungueltig: Enter the number of tails as a whole number from 1 to 20.

svg.titel: End grain of the pin board with spacing on the center line

buehne.label: 3D workpiece
buehne.fallback: 3D is not available on this device. The drawing shows the same thing.

protokoll.erklaerung: Only if you switch it on: this device stores which steps you opened and which questions you got right. No names, no time of day, nothing goes online. You can save it as a file or delete it at any time.
protokoll.studie: For a study, in addition: participation only with consent (for minors also from parents) and approval from the company or school.

xr.title: Dovetails in AR and VR
xr.lead: AR places the layout, the saw lines with their waste side and the chopping zones on your real board. VR shows the same work at a virtual workbench in slow motion, from your point of view.
xr.nichtVerfuegbar: WebXR is not available here. Open this page in the Quest 3 browser. You can see the preview below.
xr.p1: Point 1/3: tip on the TOP LEFT corner of the outside face, then press GRIP
xr.p2: Point 2/3: TOP RIGHT corner of the outside face, then press GRIP
xr.p3: Point 3/3: mark on the left edge, 100 mm below the end grain, then press GRIP
xr.ohneController: You need a controller to align the board.
xr.nichtAusgerichtet: Not aligned yet. Clamp the board, mark a point 100 mm below the end grain, then press "Align board".
xr.grenzwertig: borderline — check the lines with a rule
xr.ungueltig: The three points are almost in a line. Please align again.
xr.pruefen: Check every projected line with a rule before you mark it. The headset is not a measuring tool.
xr.masseEigen: Your measurements from the calculator: {b} × {d} mm

meta.title: Spike: wood on the Quest (measurement page)
meta.description: Internal measurement page for the Quest 3: one board with a wood surface, frame rate over 60 seconds. Not teaching content.

spikeHolz.hinweis: Measurement page for the Quest 3 – not teaching content
spikeHolz.lead: One board {b} × {d} × {l} mm with a wood surface. Put the headset on, start VR or AR, press “Start measurement” and look calmly at the board for {s} seconds. Afterwards the panel and this page show mean, 1% low, minimum, frame count and the verdict (target {ziel} Hz). “Switch surface” lets you measure plan B (baked texture).
spikeHolz.nichtVerfuegbar: WebXR is not available here. Open this page in the Quest 3 browser. Below you see the preview; a measurement here only measures this device.
spikeHolz.ergebnis: Mean {mittel} fps · 1% low {low} fps · minimum {min} fps · {frames} frames
